reshape-your-life 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release.
- Provides structured guidance for users feeling lost or stuck, based on NLP六层模型 (精神/使命、身份、BVR、能力、行为、环境).
- Includes specific prompts, action steps, and environmental tips to help users rethink and plan life from the top level.
- Offers ready-to-use opening script for empathy-driven engagement.
- Includes practical examples for various real-life scenarios (职场、创业、中年危机).
- No dependencies or prior preparation required.
